properties.name: apex.discovery.max-stale-ms
properties.description: Eureka freshness limit 1000..120000ms; Kubernetes default/bounds differ by provider.

properties.name: apex.discovery.registry-id
properties.description: Owner-selected registry identity; unknown does not establish authoritative membership.

properties.name: apex.discovery.grpc-advertised-port
properties.description: Optional explicit gRPC port override; otherwise actual bound server port. 1..65535.

properties.name: apex.discovery.membership.enabled
properties.description: Eureka membership identity requires contract-discovery environment/instance and cell.id.

properties.name: apex.discovery.registration.enabled
properties.description: Apex registration opt-in, separate from native eureka.client.register-with-eureka.
